name: FetchLumaBlock
evidence: original assembly: copies a luma block of whole pixels to the prediction buffer, widening bytes to halfwords (entry 0 of the luma table D_0027B000)

name: FetchChromaBlock
evidence: original assembly: copies a chroma block of whole pixels to the prediction buffer (entry 0 of the chroma table D_0027B020)

name: FetchLumaBlockHalfVertical
evidence: original assembly: fetches a luma block half a pixel off vertically, averaging each row with the next (entry 1 of the luma table D_0027B000)

name: FetchChromaBlockHalfVertical
evidence: original assembly: fetches a chroma block half a pixel off vertically (entry 1 of the chroma table D_0027B020)

name: FetchLumaBlockHalfHorizontal
evidence: original assembly: fetches a luma block half a pixel off horizontally (entry 2 of the luma table D_0027B000)

name: FetchChromaBlockHalfHorizontal
evidence: original assembly: fetches a chroma block half a pixel off horizontally (entry 2 of the chroma table D_0027B020)

name: FetchLumaBlockHalfBoth
evidence: original assembly: fetches a luma block half a pixel off both ways (entry 3 of the luma table D_0027B000)

name: FetchChromaBlockHalfBoth
evidence: original assembly: fetches a chroma block half a pixel off both ways (entry 3 of the chroma table D_0027B020)

name: BlendLumaBlock
evidence: original assembly: whole-pixel luma fetch averaged with the prediction already in the buffer, for a second prediction (entry 4 of the luma table D_0027B000)

name: BlendChromaBlock
evidence: original assembly: whole-pixel chroma fetch averaged with the prediction already in the buffer (entry 4 of the chroma table D_0027B020)

name: BlendLumaBlockHalfVertical
evidence: original assembly: half-pixel vertical luma fetch averaged with the buffer's prediction (entry 5 of the luma table D_0027B000)

name: BlendChromaBlockHalfVertical
evidence: original assembly: half-pixel vertical chroma fetch averaged with the buffer's prediction (entry 5 of the chroma table D_0027B020)

name: BlendLumaBlockHalfHorizontal
evidence: original assembly: half-pixel horizontal luma fetch averaged with the buffer's prediction (entry 6 of the luma table D_0027B000)

name: BlendChromaBlockHalfHorizontal
evidence: original assembly: half-pixel horizontal chroma fetch averaged with the buffer's prediction (entry 6 of the chroma table D_0027B020)

name: BlendLumaBlockHalfBoth
evidence: original assembly: half-pixel luma fetch both ways averaged with the buffer's prediction (entry 7 of the luma table D_0027B000)

name: BlendChromaBlockHalfBoth
evidence: original assembly: half-pixel chroma fetch both ways averaged with the buffer's prediction (entry 7 of the chroma table D_0027B020)

name: AddAndClampMacroblock
evidence: original assembly: adds the prediction and the decoded residual halfword by halfword, clamps each to 0 to 255 and packs them to bytes, 24 times 32 bytes (AddMacroblockResiduals calls it for a macroblock that is neither intra nor skipped)

name: ClampMacroblock
evidence: original assembly: clamps a macroblock's halfwords to 0 to 255 and packs them to bytes, 24 times 32 bytes (AddMacroblockResiduals calls it for an intra or skipped macroblock)
